questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Physical Properties of Soils & Three-Phase System
questions.text: Draw 3-Phase diagrams for soil (Partially saturated, Fully saturated, and Oven-dry). Derive the fundamental soil volume-weight relationships: (a) $e = \frac{w G}{S_r}$, (b) $\gamma = \frac{(G + S_r e)\gamma_w}{1 + e}$, (c) $\gamma_{sat} = \frac{(G + e)\gamma_w}{1 + e}$, and (d) $\gamma_d = \frac{\gamma}{1 + w} = \frac{G \gamma_w}{1 + e}$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Soil Classification & Compaction of Soils
questions.text: A partially saturated soil sample has a total volume of $1000\,\text{cm}^3$ and mass $1900\,\text{g}$. After oven drying, mass is $1600\,\text{g}$. If specific gravity $G = 2.68$, compute: (a) Water content $w$, (b) Void ratio $e$, (c) Porosity $n$, (d) Degree of saturation $S_r$, and (e) Air content $a_c$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Soil Classification & Compaction of Soils
questions.text: Explain Atterberg Limits (Liquid Limit $LL$, Plastic Limit $PL$, Shrinkage Limit $SL$). Define Plasticity Index ($I_p = LL - PL$), Liquidity Index ($I_L = \frac{w - PL}{I_p}$), Consistency Index ($I_c$), and Activity of Clay ($A = \frac{I_p}{\%<2\mu\text{m}}$). Classify fine-grained soils using Casagrande's Plasticity Chart ($A$-line equation: $I_p = 0.73(LL - 20)$).

State Darcy's Law for 1D flow through saturated porous media ($v = k i$). Differentiate between Discharge Velocity $v$ and Seepage Velocity $v_s = v/n$. Derive expressions for coefficient of permeability $k$ using: (a) Constant Head Permeameter ($k = \frac{Q L}{A h t}$), and (b) Falling (Variable) Head Permeameter ($k = \frac{a L}{A t} \ln\frac{h_1}{h_2}$).

Derive the equivalent permeability for stratified soil deposits: (a) Flow parallel to bedding planes ($k_x = \frac{\sum k_i H_i}{\sum H_i}$), and (b) Flow perpendicular to bedding planes ($k_z = \frac{\sum H_i}{\sum (H_i / k_i)}$). Prove that $k_x \ge k_z$.

Derive 2D Laplace equation for steady-state seepage: $\frac{\partial^2 h}{\partial x^2} + \frac{\partial^2 h}{\partial z^2} = 0$. Define Flow Net, Flow Lines, and Equipotential Lines. Derive the formula for seepage discharge through a weir foundation: $q = k H \frac{N_f}{N_d}$. What is Critical Hydraulic Gradient ($i_{cr} = \frac{G - 1}{1 + e}$) and Quick Sand condition?

State Terzaghi's Effective Stress Principle: $\sigma' = \sigma - u$. Draw total stress, pore water pressure, and effective stress diagrams for a soil stratum with: (a) Static water table, (b) Upward seepage flow, and (c) Downward seepage flow.

State Boussinesq's theory assumptions for point load $Q$ on a semi-infinite elastic medium: $\sigma_z = \frac{3Q}{2\pi z^2} \left[1 + \left(\frac{r}{z}\right)^2\right]^{-5/2} = I_B \frac{Q}{z^2}$. Explain Newmark's Influence Chart and 2:1 Stress Distribution Method for rectangular loaded footings.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Soil Classification & Compaction of Soils
questions.text: Compare Standard Proctor Compaction Test vs Modified Proctor Compaction Test. Explain Optimum Moisture Content (OMC) and Maximum Dry Density (MDD). What is the Zero Air Void line ($\gamma_d = \frac{G\gamma_w}{1 + wG}$)?

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Consolidation & Settlement Analysis of Soil Layers
questions.text: Derive Terzaghi's 1D Consolidation Differential Equation: $\frac{\partial u}{\partial t} = C_v \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial z^2}$ where $C_v = \frac{k}{m_v \gamma_w}$. State all underlying assumptions in Terzaghi's consolidation theory. Define Coefficient of Compressibility ($a_v$), Coefficient of Volume Compressibility ($m_v$), and Compression Index ($C_c = 0.009(LL - 10)$).

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Consolidation & Settlement Analysis of Soil Layers
questions.text: A $4.0\,\text{m}$ thick normally consolidated clay layer has initial void ratio $e_0 = 0.85$, $LL = 45\%$, and initial effective overburden pressure $\sigma_0' = 120\,\text{kN/m}^2$. If construction of a building increases stress by $\Delta\sigma' = 60\,\text{kN/m}^2$, calculate ultimate consolidation settlement ($S_c$). If $C_v = 3.5 \times 10^{-4}\,\text{cm}^2/\text{s}$ with two-way drainage, calculate the time required for $50\%$ consolidation ($T_{v50} = 0.197$).

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Soil Classification & Compaction of Soils
questions.text: State Mohr-Coulomb Failure Criterion for soils: $\tau_f = c' + \sigma' \tan\phi'$. Derive the relationship between Principal Stresses at failure: $\sigma_1' = \sigma_3' \tan^2\left(45^\circ + \frac{\phi'}{2}\right) + 2c'\tan\left(45^\circ + \frac{\phi'}{2}\right) = \sigma_3' N_\phi + 2c'\sqrt{N_\phi}$.

Explain Triaxial Shear Tests: (a) Unconsolidated Undrained (UU) test, (b) Consolidated Undrained (CU) test with pore pressure measurement (Skempton's pore pressure parameters $A$ and $B$), and (c) Consolidated Drained (CD) test. Draw Mohr circles and failure envelopes.

Two identical specimens of saturated clay were tested in triaxial apparatus. Specimen 1 under cell pressure $\sigma_3 = 150\,\text{kN/m}^2$ failed at deviator stress $\sigma_d = 240\,\text{kN/m}^2$. Specimen 2 under $\sigma_3 = 300\,\text{kN/m}^2$ failed at $\sigma_d = 380\,\text{kN/m}^2$. Determine the shear strength parameters $c'$ and $\phi'$ both analytically and graphically.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Soil Classification & Compaction of Soils
questions.text: Classify a soil having $60\%$ passing $4.75\,\text{mm}$ sieve, $45\%$ passing $75\,\mu\text{m}$ sieve, $LL = 42\%$, and $PL = 22\%$ according to Unified Soil Classification System (USCS) and AASHTO system.

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Consolidation & Settlement Analysis of Soil Layers
questions.text: Explain Square Root of Time Fitting Method (Taylor's method) and Logarithm of Time Fitting Method (Casagrande's method) for determining Coefficient of Consolidation $C_v$ from laboratory oedometer test data.
Explain Direct Shear Box Test and Unconfined Compressive Strength (UCS) test ($q_u = 2 c_u$). Discuss advantages and limitations of the direct shear test.
